clue.text: Present licence taking in account one's sweetheart

indicators.note: the licence word takes the account abbreviation inside it

parts.note: a charter is a formal grant of rights, a licence
one is I (the Roman numeral) and the 's is S
the heart of sweet is its middle letter, a crossword staple

explanation.surface: Someone hands over a licence that names their account and their beloved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Present' is a verb here, to portray, not a gift or the current moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to portray or depict someone in a particular way is to present them.

clue.text: Rogue wearing suit is 21, maybe

indicators.note: the suit is worn around the rogue, so it wraps the rogue word

parts.note: a case is a legal suit or action in court
a cad is a dishonourable man, a rogue

explanation.surface: A scoundrel in a lawsuit is likened to the entry at 21.
explanation.walkthrough: 21 across is NIAGARA, a famous waterfall; 'maybe' flags it as one example of the class.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the famous falls are one instance of a waterfall, a tumbling stream of water.

clue.text: Best could be one of worst

definitions.text: Best could be one of worst

parts.words: Best could be one of worst
parts.note: best and worst are opposites, so best is one such opposite of worst

explanation.surface: Someone at the top could be among the poorest performers.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads like a comment on ranking; really it is about the words themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: A word of opposite meaning to another is the grammatical term asked for here.

clue.text: Terrible idea so far previously mentioned

indicators.note: a terrible idea is a mess, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dreadful plan up to this point is dismissed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something stated earlier in a document has been referred to before.

clue.text: All performers express disapproval on sex being raised

parts.note: tut is the sound or verb of mild disapproval

indicators.note: in a down entry, raising a word turns it upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: it is a coy word for sex or sex appeal

explanation.surface: Someone tuts at sex being brought up in conversation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' is a down-clue link: the first piece sits on top of the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Musical term: an instruction for every player in the ensemble to perform together.

clue.text: Bird identified by crows?

parts.note: crows is not the black birds but the verb: the cock-a-doodle-doo call of a male fowl

explanation.surface: A bird recognised by the company of crows it keeps.
explanation.walkthrough: Crows reads as the plural noun for black birds; it is the verb for the morning call.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: the male farmyard fowl is known for crowing at dawn.

clue.text: Small airline serving part of Russia

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
Iberia is the Spanish national airline

explanation.surface: A little carrier runs flights to a Russian region.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the vast northern Asian region is a part of the Russian Federation.

clue.text: Drunk on pub terrace displaying beer belly?

indicators.note: drunk means the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: A tipsy drinker on a pub's terrace shows off a paunch.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a paunch is a bulge sticking out from the body, a swelling or bump.

clue.text: Extravagant old gentleman sent back dish

indicators.note: a dish sent back in a restaurant suggests the pieces read in reverse order

parts.note: OTT, over the top, means extravagant
sir is the title or address for a gentleman

explanation.surface: A flamboyant elderly diner returns his meal to the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an Italian rice preparation cooked in stock is a dish.

clue.text: Revolutionary artist with brush tip spoils icon collection

indicators.note: something revolutionary turns over, so the whole string reads backwards

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist

indicators.note: the tip of brush is its first letter

parts.note: loot means the spoils of a robbery or war

explanation.surface: A radical painter whose brush tip ruins a religious icon set.
explanation.walkthrough: Icons here are computer screen symbols, not religious paintings.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a row of clickable symbols in software gathered as a strip on screen.

clue.text: Earn more until cut changes salary

indicators.note: changes means the letters are rearranged
cut means the word until loses its final letter

explanation.surface: Earning more until a pay cut alters one's wages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' trims until to UNTI, which joins EARNMORE before 'changes' rearranges them.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: payment for work done, such as wages, is a salary.

clue.text: Teacher losing last resistance for European student

indicators.note: losing last says the final resistance letter of the teacher word is dropped
for says the European letter replaces the dropped one

parts.note: a trainer is someone who teaches skills, a teacher
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A teacher stops resisting and takes a European pupil.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone being taught a job or skill is a learner or student.

clue.text: Short-term trendy cut involves energy

parts.note: in means fashionable, trendy

indicators.note: the cut word involves, takes inside, the energy symbol

parts.note: trim means a cut, as of hair
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A fashionable haircut that lasts only a little while takes some effort.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: provisional or temporary arrangements last only for a short time.

clue.text: Flash around river reveals fish

indicators.note: the flash word goes around the river letter

parts.note: a beam is a flash or ray of light

explanation.surface: A light flashing over a stream shows a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a freshwater carp-family species is a fish.

clue.text: 'Relate' being bold to break up a heartache?

indicators.note: the bold word breaks up the a-and-heartache string by sitting inside it

parts.note: pain means distress, heartache
pert means cheeky, bold

explanation.surface: Relate, a counselling service, is bold in trying to mend a broken heart.
explanation.walkthrough: Relate is a UK relationship counselling charity, which shapes the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to belong or pertain to something is to relate to it.

clue.text: China working on replica

indicators.note: working means the letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: China is busy making a copy.
explanation.walkthrough: China looks like the country; it is the fine ceramic.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: fine ceramic tableware is called china.

clue.text: Nudge holding a balance

indicators.note: the nudge word holds the a inside it

parts.note: a reminder is a nudge to the memory

explanation.surface: A prod keeps someone from falling over.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: what is left over, as in the balance of a sum, is what remains.

clue.text: This person fronts a bank, getting richer

indicators.note: fronts means the person word stands in front of the rest

parts.note: this person is the speaker, me
a tier is a row or bank, as of seats

explanation.surface: I am the face of a bank and growing wealthier.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a heartier, more substantial dish or argument is richer in substance.

clue.text: Roman perhaps flipping great penetrating translation of Latin

indicators.note: the reversed great word penetrates, goes inside, the rearranged letters
translation of means the letters of Latin are converted into a new order
flipping turns the great word backwards

parts.note: A1 means first-class, great, with the 1 read as I

explanation.surface: A Roman flips over a great rendering of Latin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flipping' looks like a mild oath before great; it reverses AI to IA, which goes inside ITALN, the anagram of LATIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a resident of Rome is one native of that country.

clue.text: Part initially revolving or turning over rapidly

definitions.text: Part initially revolving or turning over rapidly

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of each following word

explanation.surface: A component that, from the start, spins or turns over quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines it too: a part that revolves rapidly.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: the spinning assembly in an engine or helicopter turns rapidly.

clue.text: Check Queen record oddly unlisted

parts.note: R is short for Regina, Latin for queen
an EP is an extended-play record

indicators.note: oddly means take the odd-numbered letters of unlisted

explanation.surface: Check whether a Queen record is strangely missing from the catalogue.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to drive back or halt an attack is to check it.

clue.text: However tense, meditation is the answer

parts.note: though can mean however, as in he left, though
T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: Despite stress, quiet contemplation is the solution.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: reflection or contemplation is careful mental consideration.

clue.text: A torrent going over round grand American falls

indicators.note: the turned string goes round the grand and American letters
going over means the a-and-torrent string is turned back to front

parts.note: rain falling in torrents is a downpour
G is slang for a grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: A torrent of water tumbles over a vast US waterfall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going over' reverses A RAIN to NIARA; 'round' puts it around GA.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the North American waterfalls on the US-Canada border.

clue.text: Cheers up endlessly minute garret

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word reads backwards

parts.note: ta is British slang for thanks, cheers

indicators.note: endlessly means the minute word loses its last letter

parts.note: a tick is a moment, a minute

explanation.surface: Cheers go up for a tiny loft room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'minute' looks like tiny; it is the noun, a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a room just under the roof of a house is a garret.

clue.text: Use former wife's intrigue to keep single

parts.note: ex means a former wife; the 's joins her to what follows

indicators.note: the intrigue word keeps the single letter inside it

parts.note: a plot is a scheme, intrigue
I is the Roman numeral one, single

explanation.surface: An ex-wife schemes to stay unmarried.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to take advantage of or utilise something is to use it.

clue.text: English Literature First for snob

parts.note: 1st is first, with the 1 read as I

explanation.surface: A first in English Literature is the mark of a snob.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a person who believes in rule by a superior few is a snob.

clue.text: Caught in final leg, rowed briskly

indicators.note: caught in means the letters are held inside the following words

explanation.surface: A rower went quickly in the final stretch.
explanation.definitionFit: Musical direction: an instruction meaning play fast and lively, briskly.

clue.text: Excellent time raced before finish in track

indicators.note: before says the earlier pieces come ahead of the rest

parts.note: ran means raced

indicators.note: the finish word goes in the track word

parts.note: a scent is a trail or track followed by hounds
end means finish

explanation.surface: A superb runner raced before finishing on a track.
explanation.walkthrough: 'track' looks like a running track; it is a scent trail.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: surpassing ordinary limits makes something supreme or excellent.
